desc: The latest edition of Springfield's most popular pistol is engineered in a slim, single-stack frame, and offers upgrades from the inside out. The XD-S Mod.2 features a higher hand position, enhanced grip texturing, thinner slide, an Ameriglo Pro-Glo front sight with tactical-rack rear sight. Other features include a loaded chamber indicator and a grip safety. The width of the grip is a mere .975, and the Mod.2 grip texturing gives the operator a solid feel and secure hold of the pistol.
